default.description: What every delivered file should do: PDF fonts embedded, HTML and SVG self-contained, PowerPoint text left editable.

print-letter-bleed.description: Press-ready US Letter PDF: 8.5 x 11 in trim, 0.125 in bleed with TrimBox and BleedBox, fonts embedded, CMYK, total ink at most 300%.

print-a4-bleed.description: Press-ready A4 PDF: 210 x 297 mm trim, 3 mm bleed with TrimBox and BleedBox, fonts embedded, CMYK, total ink at most 300%.

office-pdf.description: A PDF for screen and office printers: fonts embedded, RGB, no bleed required.

instagram-feed.description: Instagram feed post: 1080 px wide JPEG or PNG between 4:5 portrait and 1.91:1 landscape, RGB, no transparency, under 8 MB.

web-banner.description: Website banner image: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF in RGB, at least 1200 px wide, under 300 KB.

display-ad.description: IAB display ad: a standard size (300x250, 728x90, 160x600, 300x600, 320x50, 970x250), RGB, under 150 KB.

slides-pptx.description: An editable PowerPoint deck: text kept as text frames and charts as native charts.

web-html.description: A self-contained HTML page: nothing loaded from the network or from other files.
